Privacy Policy

This is an English translation of the Zásady ochrany osobních údajů. In case of any discrepancy, the Czech version prevails.

This privacy policy (the “Policy”) describes how Mykhailo Hyndriuk processes personal data obtained through the website hyndriuk.cz .

  1. Data controller

    The controller of your personal data is:

    • Name: Mykhailo Hyndriuk
    • Company ID (IČ): 19518617
    • Contact e-mail: mykhailo@hyndriuk.cz
    • Phone: +420 777 781 600

    (hereinafter the Controller)

  2. What personal data I process and why

    I only process data that you provide yourself when using the “Request a quote” contact form or in direct communication.

    A) Data from the contact form and direct communication

    Purpose: Handling an enquiry, a request for a quote or an order of services (IT support, digitalization, robotics, software development, AI automation, consulting).

    Categories of data:

    • Identification: name
    • Contact: e-mail, phone (if you include it in your message)
    • Content: the text of your message (the enquiry itself)

    Legal basis: The Controller's legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries and questions. Where the enquiry leads to the conclusion of a contract, the legal basis is the performance of a contract or steps taken prior to entering into a contract.

    Retention period: For the time strictly necessary to handle the enquiry and no longer than 1 year after the end of communication if no cooperation follows, or longer where necessary to protect the Controller's legitimate interests (e.g. in the event of a dispute).

    B) Technical and operational data

    Purpose: Ensuring the correct and secure operation of the website.

    Categories of data: IP address, server log files, browser type, language settings.

    Legal basis: The Controller's legitimate interest in ensuring the technical functionality and security of the website.

    Retention period: For the time strictly necessary for operation, usually several weeks.

  3. Recipients of personal data (processors)

    Your personal data may be accessed by third parties that provide technical and operational services to the Controller:

    • Providers of IT services, hosting and website maintenance – GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.).
    • No analytics tools are used.

    The Controller does not transfer personal data outside the EU/EEA.

  4. Your rights

    In connection with the processing of your personal data, you have the following rights under the GDPR:

    • The right of access to your personal data.
    • The right to rectification or completion of inaccurate or incomplete data.
    • The right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”) where the data is no longer needed for the purpose of processing.
    • The right to restriction of processing.
    • The right to object to processing (in particular processing based on legitimate interest).
    • The right to data portability (where processing is based on a contract).
    • The right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In the Czech Republic this is the Office for Personal Data Protection (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, ÚOOÚ), Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, e-mail: posta@uoou.cz.

    You can exercise these rights in writing at the Controller's registered address or by e-mail at mykhailo@hyndriuk.cz.

  5. Security

    The Controller has adopted and maintains technical and organisational measures to ensure the security of your personal data. The website is protected by HTTPS encryption, which ensures that data transfer (including data from the contact form) is secure.

    This Privacy Policy is valid and effective from 2 October 2025.
